verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only per-object operations, such as creating a single Card or Cardholder. Nothing shows a bulk or batch endpoint, or a Dashboard bulk action, for acting on many cards, cardholders or disputes at once. A developer could loop over the single-object API, but that is a building block, not a bulk-operations capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
